overrides.value: Translates selected notes and PDFs in batches through services such as Google, DeepL, and Baidu, some of which need a key, turns PDFs into notes, and makes image and table annotations automatically.
overrides.reason: Condensed from addon/locale/en-US/addon.ftl, since README.md, which is in Chinese, gives only install and menu steps. The manifest description, "zotero-translate-ant", is in English and has fewer than six words, and the GitHub About text is missing.
